top_choice_rationale: P003 rests on a sharp quantitative prediction (near-flat bands at the magic angle in the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model) followed by a decisive experiment (correlated insulators and superconductivity), since reproduced across graphene multilayers and moire platforms. The citation is scoped to flat bands and observed correlated states, not the pairing mechanism. I accept that the experimental credit (Cao, Fatemi and others) is narrower than the work and that the case for waiting is respectable, so P001 follows closely: it is the cleanest, independently verified achievement, with clock-to-clock agreement at the 1e-18 level.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; electronic-structure and 2D-materials work is neighbouring to P003 but no documented connection to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer
